actions.action: Trace edits through resolved token dependencies
actions.mechanism: Resolve aliases separately for each brand and theme, then map changed values to actual rendered uses.
actions.implementation: Build reverse-reference indexes; traverse multi-level aliases after each edit. Display dependency paths, changed consumers, and cycle errors rather than partial results.
actions.check: Edit a three-level alias chain and verify affected consumers; introduce a cycle and verify resolution fails visibly.
actions.risk: Incomplete rendered-use data can hide affected consumers.

actions.action: Preserve brand overrides with explicit provenance
actions.mechanism: Treat intentional brand values as owned overrides, not values to normalize during base-color propagation.
actions.implementation: Label each resolved value with its source and override owner. Preserve explicit overrides; require a separate confirmed operation to replace one.
actions.check: Change a shared base token: an explicit brand override remains unchanged and traceable, while a brand alias follows its reference.
actions.risk: Preserved overrides may still need contrast review against changed neighbors.

actions.action: Review affected foreground/background pairs before publishing
actions.mechanism: Evaluate rendered pairs by usage role, including tokens serving as both foreground and background.
actions.implementation: List affected pairs by brand, theme, and component with current/proposed contrast numbers, applicable thresholds, and textual review status. Flag unsupported calculations as unknown.
actions.check: Use one token as text and background in separate pairs; verify both appear and failing or unknown results require review.
actions.risk: Color checks alone cannot establish complete accessibility.

actions.action: Stage palette edits behind a publish gate
actions.mechanism: Keep proposed changes isolated until review is complete, then commit the exact reviewed revision.
actions.implementation: Provide current/proposed value tables, numeric deltas, and labeled previews. Block publishing on cycles or unresolved pair reviews; invalidate approvals after edits.
actions.check: Verify live values stay unchanged during editing, comparison works without color, and modifying an approved proposal blocks publishing again.
actions.risk: Review acknowledgement can permit poor choices; record reasons and revision history.
